description: This file contains the PHP source code defining the Category controller class for the OpenCart admin module extension. It manages the category module's settings page, including displaying the form, handling form submission, and permissions.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Controller class for managing the category module extension in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language, sets page title, prepares breadcrumb navigation, and renders the category module settings page.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the configuration of the category module, with permission checks and JSON response.
